text: Featured advantages 1. Partner universities It cooperates with Durham University (Fortune 100 in the world), Lancaster University, Coventry University and other international famous universities. 2. Cultivation mode Sino-foreign joint training, directly promoted to international famous universities master's degree. 3. Years of cultivation In China, complete the general undergraduate 4-year course in 3 years, saving students' time and capital costs for studying abroad. Cultivation goals This major is organized by our school in cooperation with international famous universities, aiming to cultivate high-end talents with international vision, advanced theories and service skills in international economics and trade, familiar with international business and trade rules, proficient in English communication skills, and competent in the global trade industry. Core courses International famous master's degree pathway course, international IELTS English course, international master's thesis guidance course, classroom group cooperation display course (Presentation), personal study abroad planning course international trade, international trade practice, international business English, cross-border e-commerce theory and practice, cross-border e-commerce project planning, international finance, international commercial law, international settlement, international business management, customs declaration and inspection practice, foreign trade documentary practice, POCIB international trade comprehensive training, etc.
